newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 91-day T-bills yield 28.99 pct - C.Bank.
newsitem.headline: Russian 91-day T-bills yield 28.99 pct - C.Bank.

text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of 91-day GKO discount Treasury bills was 28.99 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the Central Bank said.
Dealers had forecast the average yield would be in the 27.0-30.5 percent range.
The 22051 bills maturing on May 21, 1997, the closest maturity date to the new issue, closed at 94.44, yielding 25.28 percent on Tuesday. Full details of the auction follow:
On February 26 the Finance Ministry raised 5.33 trillion roubles by selling 357-day T-bills, making total proceeds from today's auctions 8.09 trillion roubles.

It had also paid about 687.12 billion roubles in interest on maturing OFZ interest-bearing bonds (series 24003) and redeemed the entire issue, in which 6.88 trillion roubles is outstanding. It has also paid about 329.48 billion roubles in interest on the series 24004 OFZ bonds.
